USAGE RULES — Microsoft Azure architecture icons in this directory
===================================================================

These icons are Microsoft trademarks. Their use is governed by the
Microsoft Azure Architecture Icons Terms of Use:

  https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/icons/

By using any icon in this directory, you agree to those Terms.

Microsoft permits the use of these icons in architectural diagrams,
training materials, or documentation. The following are prohibited
(verbatim from Microsoft):

  - Don't crop, flip, or rotate icons.
  - Don't distort or change icon shape in any way.
  - Don't use Microsoft product icons to represent your product or
    service.

For full third-party attribution, redistribution license details,
and the Microsoft Trademark and Brand Guidelines link, see the
NOTICE file at the repository root.
